answer: I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. I used iqm-client 35.0.3 through Qiskit, and the Qiskit transpiler inserted the MOVE gates that the Star architecture needs. The job ID is 01a15f3c-2172-7182-9e71-58243889580f and it finished successfully. The counts were {"000": 200}. This result comes from the free mock backend and does not reflect real GHZ statistics. The mock does not simulate the physics, so it does not return the 000/111 split that real hardware would show. No credits were used. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-63/run_ghz.py.
